socfpga_ccu_ll.h

Cache Coherency Unit (CCU) low-level driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

This header defines the primitive MMIO (Memory-Mapped I/O) accessors used to interact with the CCU hardware. Because these registers are memory-mapped, these functions rely on volatile pointer casting to ensure the compiler does not optimize out read/write operations or reorder them, ensuring that the hardware state is updated precisely when the driver intends.

socfpga_ccu_ll_read
uint32_t socfpga_ccu_ll_read(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
offset
)

Performs a synchronous, volatile 32-bit Memory-Mapped I/O (MMIO) read operation from the CCU peripheral's address space.

This function calculates the effective address by adding the `offset` to the provided `base_address`. It then performs a direct load instruction, guaranteeing that the value is fetched from the actual hardware register rather than a cached or register-optimized value.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The physical base address assigned to the CCU IP block.

offset
uint32_t

The 32-bit aligned register offset to read from.

Returns

The raw 32-bit value retrieved from the specified hardware register.

socfpga_ccu_ll_write
void socfpga_ccu_ll_write(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
offset,
uint32_t 
value
)

Performs a synchronous, volatile 32-bit Memory-Mapped I/O (MMIO) write operation to the CCU peripheral's address space.

This function calculates the effective address by adding the `offset` to the provided `base_address`. It performs a direct store instruction, guaranteeing that the write transaction reaches the hardware interface immediately, which is essential for triggering control logic (such as starting a cache flush or updating a filter mask).

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The physical base address assigned to the CCU IP block.

offset
uint32_t

The 32-bit aligned register offset to write to.

value
uint32_t

The 32-bit data payload to commit to the hardware.
